You can register for an account using your Lingnan University email address (@ln.hk). You need to verify your student email first, then set a password and username. After registration, you can link your Google account for easier login.
Why do I need to create an account to submit reviews or ask questions?

Creating an account helps maintain community quality and security. However, you can choose to submit reviews, questions, or answers anonymously. We protect your identity privacy and will not disclose your real identity to any third parties.

Yes, your passwords are completely secure. We use industry-standard security measures to protect your credentials: Your passwords are hashed using Argon2, a state-of-the-art password hashing algorithm. All data transmission is encrypted using HTTPS/TLS, ensuring your credentials are sent securely over the internet. Our backend infrastructure follows strict security protocols to safeguard your personal information.
We are committed to protecting your privacy. All user identities are kept strictly confidential and we do not share personal information with third parties.

After logging in, you can submit reviews in two ways: 1) Navigate to the course page and click the \"Write Review\" button, or 2) Visit an instructor\'s page and click the \"Submit Review\" button (which will pre-select that instructor and show only courses they teach). You can provide detailed ratings on workload, difficulty, usefulness, teaching quality, and grading satisfaction using our 5-star system with half-star precision. You can also select \"N/A\" for ratings that don\'t apply. All fields including comments are required. The system supports anonymous submissions (default), multiple instructor evaluations, markdown formatting, and includes a live preview feature.
How to search for courses and instructors?
Use the search bar at the top to enter course codes, course names, or lecturer names. You can also use filter functions to narrow your search by department, difficulty, and other criteria.
How does the rating system work?

We use a 1-5 star rating system. 1 star means very dissatisfied, 5 stars means very satisfied. The overall rating is the average of all user ratings and updates in real-time to reflect the latest reviews.

Yes, you can choose to submit reviews anonymously. When submitting a review, simply check the \"Anonymous\" option, and your username will not be displayed with the review. This helps protect your privacy while still allowing you to share valuable feedback about courses and instructors.
What languages does the website support?
Our website supports Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese, and English. You can switch languages using the language selector in the top right corner of the page, and your preference will be saved.
How often is course information updated?
We regularly update course information, including new courses and lecturer changes. Reviews and ratings are updated in real-time. If you find any outdated or incorrect information, please contact us.
Do I need to sign up to view reviews?
No, sign up is not required to view reviews. However, you must sign up with a valid Lingnan email address to post reviews, as well as to view study materials and past exam papers.

All services provided on this website are free. However, if you would like to donate, you can click the donate button in the footer to help me cover part of the operational cost. Any help is highly appreciated.
Why are there separate Courses and Instructors pages?

We provide both pages to give you different perspectives when exploring academic information. The Courses page helps you find specific courses and see all instructors who teach them, while the Instructors page lets you discover all courses taught by a particular instructor. For example, if you like a professor\'s teaching style from one course, you can easily find other courses they teach to continue learning with them.
Why can I only submit a limited number of reviews per course?

To maintain the quality and authenticity of our review system, we limit each user to a maximum of 2 reviews per course. Normally, you can submit 1 review per course. However, if your first review shows a fail grade (F), you may submit one additional review. This policy helps prevent spam, fake reviews, and review manipulation while still allowing students who retake failed courses to share their updated experience.
